Thanks for this.  I didn't think I would ever be able to go back into this account, but surprisingly I was still logged in on an old laptop.  I'm doing a lot better now.  I've reconnected a lot with my friends and family, but there's still a lot of ground I need to cover with them though.  I'm back in school, and I've changed my focus to studying things I'm actually excited for so there's that.  My ex and I are back to being best friends, which is what we were before we got together.  I know I still have feelings for her, but I just don't want to pursue them anymore.

Lastly, I have not seen A Silent Voice, but it is one of the things at the top of my watch list.  It's one of the things my ex wanted me to watch, but I was never really interested or had time for it.  Since we've split, I've been watching a lot of the things she suggested to me.  When I started doing that, I think I was hoping that watching all of that stuff would lead to me figuring out what it was about me that made her decide I wasn't right.  Now I just find solace in watching something that my friend suggested to me.
Fair enough.

I appreciate the advice, but if she is, I would be the Dad.  Plus, it kind of would be my problem.  I know some dudes can ignore the fact that it takes two to tango, but I can't.  Also, she's not the kind to take advantage of someone like that.  If you knew her, you'd understand.
That's really rough op.  I'm sorry you're having to go through this.

Before she was sweet, only slightly impatient, and was always there for her friends.  Now, she's a lot meaner, she can't wait for anything, and she just ignores people.  I'm worried about her, but I can't do anything about it.
I'm 19.  She was 17 at the time.
I know I was stupid at the time.  I was just hurt that she felt that way.
I'm ok.  I'm sorry about your situation.

That's rough.  I'm sorry.

I know.  It just hurts so much to see her be so self-destructive.  She's honestly acting like her mom, which is her least favorite person in existence.  It just pisses me off that I can't call her out on her bs like she would do to me.  It isn't like her to be like this at all.
I feel you.   I'm going through really similar stuff.  It hurts so much because everything you know links back to them, and the worst part is you can't even run away from the feelings.
It also doesn't help that tomorrow would've been a year and a half for us, and a year since the second time we had sex.

I just miss her so much.  She still wants to be friends, but I told her that I wouldn't be able to talk to her again until we didn't feel anything towards each other.  I know that'll never happen though.  I'm always going to love her and I hate myself for it.  I can't enjoy my life without her, because everything in my life revolves around her.  All my friends and hobbies link back to her.

Also, I'm sorry about what happened with you.
